title: Repurposing 200+ year old windows for R&SVP - Hio Ridge Barn Venue, Bridgton, Maine
description: When your husband says you need to put dual pane windows in your 200+ year old New Englander...you put them in the barn and create a lovely barn venue!!!  For more information:  Susan@437hioridge.events

title: R&SVP - Hio Ridge - From Old Barn and Ell sitting on a few rocks to a stunning barn venue
description: It has been a fun challenge to take a 200+ year old house, barn and ell that had been in the family for 4 generations and turn it into a stunning event space.  We repurposed everything possible.  The original windows now provide natural lighting in the barn.  The original exterior barn boards now line the interior of the barn.  The ell has been converted into beautiful spaces for the bride and groom and their parties to get ready for their big day!  Stay tuned for more reels showing the transformation.
